title: SIM swap and OTP in practice
intro: Lose your number, lose your accounts. Decide what you would do in each moment from this module's lessons.

decisions.title: SahilTel: No service

artifact.title: SahilTel: No service
body: Emergency calls only. SIM card not recognised.

options.label: Call the operator from another phone
Turn the phone off and sleep

decisions.explain: If your number moved to another card, the operator can block it and give it back to you.

decisions.title: Call from SahilTel Customer Service

artifact.name: SahilTel Customer Service
body: Hello, this is Gunel from SahilTel. Old SIM cards, excuse me, are being switched off this month, so we are renewing yours for free.

options.label: All right, what should I do?
I will call the operator's official number myself

decisions.explain: If a renewal is real, the official line will confirm it.

decisions.title: UlduzBank Mobil: Sign-in from a new device
decisions.prompt: The SIM is dead, but the bank app still reaches you over home internet. What do you do?

artifact.title: UlduzBank Mobil: Sign-in from a new device
body: Android, Ganja, 00:27. If this was not you, freeze your card.

options.label: Open the app and freeze the card

decisions.explain: No money leaves a frozen card, and you can unfreeze it later with the bank.

decisions.title: Message from UlduzBank

artifact.name: UlduzBank
body: Your sign-in code: 482193. Do not tell this code to anyone.

decisions.explain: If you asked for this code yourself, it is a normal message. Type the code in yourself and nowhere else.

decisions.title: Message from SahilTel

artifact.name: SahilTel
body: A request to replace the SIM card for your number has been received.

decisions.explain: If you did not ask for a new SIM, this is the first sign of an attack. Call your operator at once.
